newsitem.title: USA: BEC names Kiedaisch CEO of Bolle unit.
newsitem.headline: BEC names Kiedaisch CEO of Bolle unit.

text.p: BEC Group Inc said Thursday Gary Kiedaisch will become chief executive officer of its Bolle Inc subsidiary, a manufacturer of sunglasses and sports goggles whose acquisition was finalized today.
The company had said in June it would buy Bolle from the French holding company that controlled it in a transaction valued at $53 million.
BEC said two Bolle family members will stay on the board of Bolle Inc.
Prior to joining Bolle, BEC said Kiedaisch was president and chief executive officer of the Stowe Mountain Resort, a unit of American International Group Inc.

Last July, BEC said it planned to group together the Bolle brand name of sunglasses under one corporate umbrella and offer part of the new Bolle company to the public through an initial public offering.
